resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and the 1941 survey description give about 100 feet, while the 1964 recovery note gives an overall height of about 110 feet. The record keeps 30.5 m (100 ft), which two sources give; the 1964 figure is a single later note that does not explain the difference, so it is flagged for the editor.

notes_for_editor: Height disagreement unresolved: 100 ft (Register, 1941 description) versus about 110 ft overall (1964 recovery). Location: 1941 description says about 4 miles east of Sparkman; 1964 note says about 4-1/2 miles east-northeast. No staffing, fire, access or visit source found; the story says so. Standing status is inferred from the 2021 visit note and 1964 recovery, not stated outright by any source. Record status and access not changed.
